description: Agent memory extractor — Pull durable facts worth remembering (preferences, identity, goals, constraints, projects) out of a conversation for an AI assistant's long-term memory. Offline checks: each fact's supporting quote must appear in the text, temporary wording is marked, existing= memories (separated by ; or new lines) are matched as duplicate or update, and emails/phones are redacted while card and ID numbers are never marked for saving. Optional: subject= (default the user). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. User: I'm vegetarian and I run a bakery in Austin. Can you plan meals for this week?

name: ai_memory_extract
